items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Was that Percy McDavid's band? [INTERVIEWEE] No, we had two bands at that time. This is Millard Lacy.

ctx.x: During the sixties I was playing other types of music besides jazz. I was a member of a number of marching bands, concert bands, even a community symphony orchestra. Most of my work at that time was with the Urban Concert Band.
No, we had two bands at that time. This is Millard Lacy.
